request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: head-and-shoulders bust portrait for a game interface, level three-quarter view, the character turned slightly to the right (south-east) and looking at the viewer, head and upper chest filling most of the square, centred on a transparent background. The bust ends cleanly at the chest; nothing else is in the image.

Faction: rowdy, ramshackle scrap-heap storybook, loud and silly, never grim. Everything is made of dented riveted scrap iron plates, patched cloth and soot-black leather straps, with bolts, small spikes, square stitched patches and soot smudges as details; iron is shaded with darker blue-grey, leather with charcoal grey, cloth with a deeper tone of its own colour, never brown.
layers.negative: gun, rifle, pistol, musket, cannon, modern car, rubber tyres, chrome, headlights, neon, glowing green, lime green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, skull, bones, blood, gore, horror, wood, timber, planks, brown boots, brown leather, brown cloth, tan, bronze, copper, rust, orange rust, dark brown shading, red-brown, maroon

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute character portrait with a huge round head and big friendly eyes, the same chunky body language as the map piece, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels.
layers.negative: full body, legs, feet, standing figure, pedestal, base, plinth, frame, border, circle background, badge, medallion, vignette, background scenery, second character, crowd, text

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the subject. No other red or red-brown anywhere: every other material, and its shading, uses colours that are clearly not red or red-brown.

Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin fireworks cart shown whole: one huge fat fireworks rocket made of paper and cardboard, never metal, a stubby round cardboard tube painted plain bright red with one cream band, a pointed cream paper cone cap, a long thin pale grey launch stick sticking out behind its tail and a curly cream fuse, tilted up at forty-five degrees and pointing forward, tied with pale cream rope onto a small crooked dark gunmetal scrap cart on two mismatched dark iron wheels; a tiny goblin with yellow-olive green skin, a charcoal grey tunic and a small bright red bandana crouches beside the cart's rear wheel, apart from the rocket; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a fireworks rocket, not a missile.
The rocket's tube is plain flat bright red with a slightly darker red shadow; its cone cap, band, stick, rope and fuse are cream or pale grey, never brown; the cart is charcoal grey.
layers.negative: missile, metal rocket, tail fins, warhead, bomb, flames, explosion, brown stick, brown rope, wooden cart, red mouth, pink mouth, red eyes, brown straps, brown leather, brown skin, armour, pauldrons
